description: Implement `Extract(ExtractRequest{scenario_path}) → Graph` against `ts-morph` using a fixed Project configuration that returns files, modules, top-level declarations (components, hooks, classes, interfaces, types, functions, vars, consts), and import edges plus intra-module symbol references; byte-stable serialization for identical inputs.

requirements.description: Implement the Extract(ExtractRequest{scenario_path}) → Graph function using ts-morph with a fixed, reproducible Project configuration. The extracted graph must include all source files, module boundaries, top-level declarations (React components, hooks, classes, interfaces, types, functions, variables, and constants), import edges, and intra-module symbol references. Serialization of the resulting graph must be byte-stable: identical inputs always produce byte-for-byte identical outputs regardless of invocation time, process ID, or environment ordering.
requirements.title: Deterministic Graph Extraction via ts-morph

validation.notes: Table-driven tests for each declaration kind (component, hook, class, interface, type, function, var, const) verify correct NodeKind assignment
Test that import edge extraction captures both named and default imports with correct source/target node IDs
Test intra-module symbol reference extraction for re-used identifiers within the same file
Test byte-stable serialization: serialize the same in-memory Graph struct twice and assert byte equality
Test that serialization field ordering is deterministic (maps sorted by key, arrays sorted by stable criteria)
TCG-EXTRACT-DETERMINISM: Run Extract twice on ts-junk-drawer fixture and assert the two response payloads are byte-for-byte identical
Run Extract on ts-jsdoc-tags fixture and compare to expected-graph.json byte-for-byte
Run Extract concurrently 10 times on the same path and assert all responses are byte-for-byte identical
Verify extracted graph includes all expected nodes and edges for a known multi-file TS project
Extract completes in under 5 seconds for a 200-file TS project end-to-end including Connect-RPC and sidecar round-trip
Golden-fixture extraction from a clean clone produces output identical to the committed expected-graph.json
All declaration kinds documented in the PRD are represented in the extracted graph for a representative project

title: Deterministic Graph Extraction
